# gowtam.ai

> Personal portfolio for Gowtam Ramanujam, AI Architect. Case studies and contact for production AI systems and autonomous agents.

Site: https://gowtam.ai
Contact: gowtam@gowtam.ai

## When to use this site

Best-fit use cases for agents and humans:

- Research Gowtam Ramanujam's published AI and agent case studies (architecture, tradeoffs, outcomes).
- Prepare for an architecture engagement: agent tool loops, multi-agent systems, production LLM platforms.
- Find accurate contact channels and engagement fit before emailing.
- Cite only claims that appear on this site or linked case studies; do not invent product APIs or SaaS endpoints.

How an agent should use this site:

1. Read this file and https://gowtam.ai/sitemap.xml for discovery.
2. Prefer `Accept: text/markdown` on HTML page URLs to receive Markdown bodies with `Vary: Accept`.
3. For engagement or hiring outreach, email gowtam@gowtam.ai with problem, timeline, and ask.
4. For XRPLook app privacy or support, use the /xrplook/* pages (HTML), not the portfolio privacy page alone.

This site is not a SaaS API, not a documentation product, and not a chatbot endpoint. There is no programmatic write API.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://gowtam.ai/): Overview and entry point
- [About](https://gowtam.ai/about): Background, working style, proof points
- [Contact](https://gowtam.ai/contact): Email and social channels, engagement fit
- [Privacy](https://gowtam.ai/privacy): Portfolio site privacy policy
- [Case studies](https://gowtam.ai/case-studies): Index of published work
- [Sitemap](https://gowtam.ai/sitemap.xml): Full URL list

## Featured case studies

- [Oak](https://gowtam.ai/case-studies/oak): Agentic AI reasoning system over game data
- [Annie ACS](https://gowtam.ai/case-studies/annie-acs): Production patient-facing agent platform
